title: 最后几个问题
instructions: 下面的问题想了解你在两轮创作中的真实体验。两轮使用的文物和 AI 互动方式可能不同，请分别回想每一轮的情况。没有正确或错误答案。

questions.prompt: 第一轮使用 AI 创作时，我能够探索不同的设计想法或可能性。
questions.prompt_en: In the first round, I was able to explore different design ideas or possibilities when working with AI.

questions.prompt: 第一轮创作中，采用哪些设计想法主要由我自己决定。
questions.prompt_en: In the first round, which design ideas to adopt was mainly my own decision.

questions.prompt: 完成第一轮文创任务时，你投入了多少心理努力？
questions.prompt_en: How much mental effort did you invest in completing the first design task?

questions.prompt: 第二轮使用 AI 创作时，我能够探索不同的设计想法或可能性。
questions.prompt_en: In the second round, I was able to explore different design ideas or possibilities when working with AI.

questions.prompt: 第二轮创作中，采用哪些设计想法主要由我自己决定。
questions.prompt_en: In the second round, which design ideas to adopt was mainly my own decision.

questions.prompt: 完成第二轮文创任务时，你投入了多少心理努力？
questions.prompt_en: How much mental effort did you invest in completing the second design task?

questions.prompt: 如果只比较 AI 的互动与帮助方式，不考虑两件文物本身的差异，你更愿意在以后的文创设计中使用哪一轮的方式？
questions.prompt_en: Comparing only how the AI interacted and helped — not the two artifacts themselves — which round's approach would you prefer to use in future cultural-product design?

instructions_en: These questions ask about your real experience in the two rounds. The artifact and the way the AI interacted may have differed between rounds; please recall each round separately. There are no right or wrong answers.
